rationale: Normal band is [0.90, 1.10] pu. 8 of 10 values lie inside it (80%), below the 95% requirement, so the series is non-compliant. Values t03=0.889 and t04=0.895 are below the lower normal limit; none exceed 1.10. All values stay within the absolute limits [0.85, 1.10] pu. Applying the listed tap changes: +0.025 pu lifts the whole series into [0.90, 1.10] (10/10 inside, max 1.091 <= 1.10, min 0.914 >= 0.90) with no absolute-limit violation; +0.05 pu pushes max to 1.116, violating the absolute upper limit; 0.0 and -0.025 pu leave more values outside the normal band. Hence +0.025 pu is the best option.
